__connect_to: Name of the RPC node profile to use. Credentials for it are read from .env as RPC_<NAME>_USER/HOST/PASSWORD/PORT (see .env.example) â€” not stored here.

update_intervals.__comment: These are in seconds. price is derived from color_scheme_interval, not set here.

__chart_alternating_options: off, on. When on, the main screen alternates between the price chart and the mining dashboard.
__color_scheme_interval_options: daily, hourly, 30min, 15min, 5min (also sets candlestick width). 5min is the finest resolution the app fetches from Kraken. 'daily' is the odd one out: it fetches and displays a month of history instead of the usual 24h, so the candlestick chart has more than one bucket to draw.

__example_update_intervals.note: Price update interval is derived from color_scheme_interval. The app will set update_intervals.price automatically on startup.
